subject: Novamed exec workshop — hybrid intake, travel asks & AV/venue coordination
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novamed.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Bowers <tbowers@novamed.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood workshop — June week availability & initial logistics

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo — leadership loved the performance numbers and we'd like to lock a two-day executive workshop the week of June 22. Our ask: one day onsite in SF for ~10 execs + a half-day remote session for product/infra teams coordinated across US and EU.

High-level requests from procurement/security:
- A tentative agenda (exec + technical tracks)
- Hotel block recommendations near the venue
- Any visa or invitation letters for our EU execs (we have 3 traveling from Milan)
- AV/room needs (mic + hybrid camera setup) and rough costs

Can your team confirm availability for in-person June 23 (preferred) or June 24, with a follow-up remote half-day June 25? If those dates don't work on Redwood's side, propose alternatives in the same week.

I attached a draft agenda and the venue's floorplan (from GrandPlaza). Also looping Tom.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Partnerships — NovaMed
elena.rossi@novamed.com

Attachment: grandplaza_floorplan_A3.png

Subject: Re: Redwood workshop — June week availability & initial logistics

Elena — thanks, excited to run this. Quick confirmations and next steps below.

Availability:
- We can host an onsite exec day on June 23 (we'll mark holds) and June 24 as a backup.
- Remote half-day on June 25 works for our product + infra SMEs.

What we'll provide:
- Workshop facilitation (exec playbook + outcomes doc)
- Tech deep-dive and performance runbook for your infra team
- Backfill of AV and hybrid streaming support via our vendor partner if GrandPlaza needs bridging equipment

Can you confirm final headcount for the SF day (attendees + guests) and travel origins (so we can prepare invitation letters)? We'll follow up with hotel block options and a travel checklist.

Monica: can you take lead on venue/blocks and coordinate with GrandPlaza events?
Stephanie: please draft the calendar holds (exec day + tech half-day) and the travel checklist — include visa letter templates.
Aditya: can you own AV vendor contact & estimate?

I'll circulate a mutual action plan later today.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Field Solutions — Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood workshop — June week availability & initial logistics

Looping in VenueOps to confirm room options and rates. Elena — quick notes from my side after a venue scan:

Venue options near SFO/SoMa:
- GrandPlaza — 2 adjacent suites, seating up to 14 theater-style; hybrid camera rig available via their AV partner. Floorplan attached.
- HarborPoint Conference Center — slightly cheaper, limited camera angles; ~15 min extra transit.

Hotel block:
- I can secure a 10-room block at the GrandPlaza partner hotel at a negotiated rate (see attached spreadsheet). Will need a credit card guarantee; typical release is 21 days prior.

AV/vendor notes (Aditya to confirm):
- We'll request a hybrid AV package: 1 PTZ camera, ceiling mic, laptop uplink + encoder for streaming. Estimate $1,400-$1,900 depending on configuration.

Visa/invitation letters:
- We can produce formal invitation letters for travel purposes. Please list full legal names, passport numbers (optional on the initial mail), and travel dates. We typically include a Redwood host contact and onsite agenda.

Action items assigned:
- Monica: hold hotel block & confirm contract terms by Fri, 15 May.
- Stephanie: draft calendar holds and share ICS links (exec day + tech half-day) by EOD.
- Aditya: confirm AV quote and fallback streaming option by Thu, 14 May.

VenueOps (events@grandplaza.com) — can you confirm availability for June 23 and provide a formal quote for the hybrid AV package + break catering?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Program Manager — Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
Attachment: hotel_block_rates.xlsx

Also attaching a redline to the draft agenda — small timing tweaks for the exec Q&A and a 30-minute customer story.
